scripts.title: Remove enemies cronos crazy challenge
scripts.features: removes the thief orb and drones, will update as i find more different drones.
scripts.script:
local TARGET_NAMES = {
	ThiefOrb = true,
	Drone = true
}

local function removeIfTarget(obj)
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") and TARGET_NAMES[obj.Name] then
		obj:Destroy()
	end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	removeIfTarget(obj)
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(removeIfTarget)
